questionResults.question: Who has seen the most birds
questionResults.sql:
SELECT u.username, COUNT(bs.sighting_id) AS total_sightings
FROM `Bird Sighting` bs
JOIN `users` u ON bs.person_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.username
ORDER BY total_sightings DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Feathers_bob has seen the most birds, with a count of 11.
